patch.diff:
--- a/shopcart/cart.py
+++ b/shopcart/cart.py
@@ -29,7 +29,10 @@
         """Change the quantity of an item; a quantity of 0 removes the item."""
         if quantity < 0:
             raise ValueError("quantity cannot be negative")
-        self.items[sku][1] = quantity
+        if quantity == 0:
+            self.remove(sku)
+        else:
+            self.items[sku][1] = quantity
 
     def remove(self, sku: str) -> bool:
         """Remove an item. Returns False if it was not in the cart."""

candidates.name: Cart.set_quantity
Cart.item_count
candidates.source:
def item_count(self) -> int:
        return sum(q for _, q in self.items.values())

candidates.name: Cart.remove
Cart.subtotal
candidates.source:
def subtotal(self) -> Decimal:
        return money(sum((p.price * q for p, q in self.items.values()), Decimal("0")))

candidates.name: Cart.apply_coupon
money
candidates.source:
def money(x) -> Decimal:
    return Decimal(str(x)).quantize(Decimal("0.01"), rounding=ROUND_HALF_UP)
